propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui beatissimae semper Virginis et Genetricis tuae Mariae singulari
titulo Carmeli Ordinem decorasti: concede propitius; ut, cujus hodie
Commemorationem solemni celebramus officio, ejus muniti praesidiis, ad
gaudia sempiterna pervenire mereamur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre in
unitate.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Own-appointment historical witness. Complete petitions agree after only the exact independently recorded spelling substitutions; actual Latin conclusions are prefixes of the same own-book family who-livest, with person Prayer addressed directly to God the Son. translations.text: O God, Who hast honored the Order of the most blessed Mary, ever a virgin, Thy mother, with the special title of Carmel, graciously grant that we, who this day celebrate her commemoration with solemn service, may, being protected by her care, be worthy to attain to everlasting joys. Who livest.

Mariae intercessio veneranda: ut, quos perpetuis cumulavit beneficiis, a

regnas cum Deo Patre in unitate.
